[[ ## summary ## ]]
The claim is FALSE. Back to the Future: The Ride is no longer at Universal Studios Florida—it was replaced by The Simpsons Ride. Additionally, Springfield and its adjacent attraction (The Simpsons Ride) are located at Universal Studios Hollywood, not Universal Studios Florida. While The Simpsons Ride does exist at Universal Studios Florida, it is not adjacent to Springfield, which only exists at the Hollywood location.

[[ ## query ## ]]
What attractions are currently located at Universal Studios Florida versus Universal Studios Hollywood, specifically regarding Back to the Future: The Ride, The Simpsons Ride, and the Springfield area?
